summary: OpenAI describes how Asana used Codex to remove an outdated testing framework in two weeks with parallel coding agents, at a fraction of the previously estimated engineering cost.

practices.reason: The parallel-agent, prompt-then-review pattern described is a workable orchestration approach but is reported from one customer's specific migration, not a generalizable recipe.
practices.quote: From a five-sentence prompt, up to four coding agents worked in parallel, each in a separate copy of the codebase. An engineer checked progress twice a day and reviewed every proposed change.
